articles.summary: M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) ("Mtron" or the "Company") today announced that Cameron Pforr, Chief Executive Officer, and Chris Nossokoff, Vice President – Financial Reporting, will host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Raymond James Investor-Led Sonoma Small Cap Symposium on Monday, November 16, 2026 at The Lodge at Sonoma Resort, Autograph Collection, in Sonoma, California. Institutional investors are welcome to contact Raymond James to arrange one-on-one meetings with management. About M-tron Industries, Inc. M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) designs, manufactures, and markets highly engineered, high reliability frequency and spectrum control products and solutions to customers in the aerospace and defense, avionics, space industries. As an engineering-centric company, Mtron provides close support to its customers throughout our products' entire life cycle, including product design, prototyping, production, and subsequent product upgrades. articles.summary: M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) ("Mtron" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based supplier of radio frequency components and solutions to the aerospace defense, avionics and space industries, will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before markets open on Thursday November 12, 2026. Mtron's press release will be available on the Investor Relations website at ir.mtron.com . Mtron will also host a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET to review these results. To access the conference call, please use the dial-in information below: Toll Free Dial-in Number: +1 833-444-1612 Toll Dial-in Number: +1 206-407-3770 Conference ID: 720 204 250 Webcast URL: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/720204250 An archive will be available after the call on the Events and Presentations page on the Investor Relations section of Mtron's website at ir.mtron.com/events-and-presentations .
